newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall 3.08 pct on Somprasong, baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall 3.08 pct on Somprasong, baht.

text.p: Battered Thai stocks plunged 3.08 percent on early Wednesday afternoon as investors reacted to reports that property developer Somprasong Land Plc defaulted on interest payment of its Euroconvertible debenture (ECD), brokers said.
The SET index fell 23.61 points to near its 54-month low of 741.81 at 0747 GMT.
A financial advisor of Somprasong said the company had failed to make a $3.1 million interest payment on its ECD due on February 4.
"The report, along with worries about baht stability, induce more investors to sell," the broker said.
The index later recovered slightly, paring its loss to 21.05 points, or 2.75 percent, to stand at 744.37
